tensions.issue: Does enabled:false turn the reviewer fully off?
tensions.resolution: No — extraction off, indexing on. Draft must state this explicitly.

tensions.issue: Is the journey timeline a stored table?
tensions.resolution: No — projected from record stamps on every read. No migration/backfill story exists.
No — foreground stays user-directed; adopt is manual.

tensions.issue: Which memory write path is primary?
tensions.resolution: Both: incremental keeps long sessions useful; rebuild regenerates. Rebuild writes directly even under writeApproval.

tensions.issue: Is ranked recall the long-term memory?
tensions.resolution: No — durable record is the memory; recall is one droppable context item.
